Sự linh hoạt trong vận tải hàng hóa bằng.en: The flexibility in transit goods by foot is a time factor, the shipping site. Customers can choose the time of departure, the shipping venue in order to be most favorable to them. Additionally, road transport can combine flexibility with other vehicles and select various types of vehicles such as trucks, container cars, cranes, big cars, small cars....
Sự linh hoạt trong vận tải hàng hóa bằng.zh: 运输地点是时间因素 -- -- 运输地点 -- -- 中转货物按脚运出的灵活性。 顾客可以选择出发时间,发货地,以对他们最有利. 此外,道路运输还可以与其他车辆结合灵活性,并选择各类车辆,如卡车,集装箱车,起重机,大车,小车等.

Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, quãng đườn.en: According to Google Maps's instructions, the distance from Long An to Ning is approximately 1.36 km (4.36 km) long if running through Route 13, which is approximately 27 hours long. So the time of shipping from Long An to Ninh Ping took about 4 to 5 days.
Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, quãng đườn.zh: 根据Google Maps的指令,从长安到宁的距离如果通过13号公路运行,长约1.36公里(4.36公里),长约27小时. 因此从长安到宁平的通航时间大约需要4到5天.

Ưu điểm nổi bật nhất của phương tiện vận.zh: 这种介质最突出的优先权是比起其他运输成本更低. 事实上,如果货运的距离为650英里(650公里)左右,则只花费了大约4.55加仑(4.55L)的燃料,可恢复,低行;货物质量可以长途运输;货物是安全的,没有损失.
